Missæ sunt ergo sortes ex æquo,

the northern section was obtained by lot.
Obededom and his sons obtained that to the south,
in qua parte domus erat seniorum concilium.
in the part of the house where the council of elders was.
and Hosah obtained that toward the west,
beside the gate that leads to the way of the ascent,
toward the east there were six Levites,
and toward the north there were four per day,
atque ad meridiem similiter in die quatuor:
and then toward the south similarly there were four each day.
In cellulis quoque janitorum ad occidentem quatuor in via,
Also, in the cells of the porters toward the west, there were four along the way,
Hæ sunt divisiones janitorum filiorum Core et Merari.
These are the divisions of the porters of the sons of Kohath and of Merari.
Porro Achias erat super thesauros domus Dei,
Now Ahijah was over the treasuries of the house of God,
leaders of the families of Ladan and of Gershon:
et Joël fratres ejus super thesauros domus Domini.
his brothers were over the treasuries of the house of the Lord,
Subaël autem filius Gersom filii Moysi, præpositus thesauris.
Now, Shebuel, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was in the first place over the treasuries,
and his brothers were over the treasuries of the holy things,
super thesauros sanctorum quæ sanctificavit David rex,
with the leaders of the families,
and the commanders of the army.
These things were from the wars and from the best spoils of the battles,
quæ consecraverant ad instaurationem et supellectilem templi Domini.
which they had consecrated for the repair and the furnishing of the temple of the Lord.
Hæc autem universa sanctificavit Samuel videns,
Now all these things were sanctified by Samuel, the seer,
and by Saul, the son of Kish,
and by Abner, the son of Ner,
and by Joab, the son of Zeruiah.
omnes qui sanctificaverant ea per manum Selemith et fratrum ejus.
All those who had sanctified these were under the hand of Shelomoth and his brothers.
Yet truly, Chenaniah and his sons were over the Izharites,
et filii ejus ad opera forinsecus super Israël ad docendum et judicandum eos.
for the exterior works concerning Israel, in order to teach and to judge them.
Now from the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers,
one thousand seven hundred very strong men,
mille septingenti præerant Israëli trans Jordanem contra occidentem,
were in charge of Israel across the Jordan toward the west,
in all the works of the Lord,
and in the ministry of the king.
Hebronitarum autem princeps fuit Jeria secundum familias et cognationes eorum.
And the leader of the Hebronites was Jerijah, according to their families and kindred.
Quadragesimo anno regni David recensiti sunt,
In the fortieth year of the reign of David, they were numbered,
et inventi sunt viri fortissimi in Jazer Galaad,
and there were found very strong men in Jazer Gilead.
And his brothers of a mature age were two thousand seven hundred leaders of families.
